text:
Ivy N.: quick postmortem follow-up — we keep seeing the same late-night DB connection surge. need a compact oncall playbook (triage + one-line commands + who to page) and explicit owners so PM can close actions. who can pick sections?

Carlos R.: I can take the runbook edits: short TL;DR for oncall, exact commands, and a two-step rollback. will aim for a PR in 6 business days.

Meera S.: i'll own the alert->escalation mapping and pager text. propose we codify thresholds in the runbook so alerts reference the same values (avoid drift). sample thresholds: conn_util >= 0.80 for 7m -> L2, conn_util >= 0.95 for 2m -> L1 + exec page.

Devon T.: i'll do the automation/monitoring piece — expose conn_util, add a tiny curlable health endpoint, and a nightly smoke that exercises DB connection pooling. setting a due date of 2024-06-19.

Carlos R.: draft triage checklist i'll add:
```
# quick sanity checks for DB surge
psql -c "SELECT now(), count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# check API pod errors for connection resets
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | egrep -i "connection|timeout"
# show worker job backlog
kubectl -n prod get jobs -l job=nightly -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, active:.status.active, succeeded:.status.succeeded}'
# safe throttle: disable job runner (feature flag)
# emergency restart for worker deploy (safe)
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=60s
```

Meera S.: i'll add exact pager text templates to the runbook, e.g.:
"DB connection utilization at {{conn_util}} >= 95% for 2m. Run triage checklist. If unresolved after mitigation, page infra on-call and include tracer PID/stack traces."

ops-bot: Created actions: PM-6025 (runbook: triage checklist) assigned Carlos R. due 2024-06-12; PM-6026 (alerts + escalation thresholds) assigned Meera S. due 2024-06-10; PM-6027 (health endpoint + nightly smoke) assigned Devon T. due 2024-06-19. Link: https://tracker.redwood/PM-6025

Ivy N.: good. PM wants owners + deliverables in the tracker by EOD tomorrow. please confirm dates or update. also include a 2-line test plan in each PR so oncall can validate.

Carlos R.: confirmed. PR will include the checklist, rollback steps, and a 2-step validation (run commands + confirm conn_util drops). setting PM-6025 to 2024-06-12.

Meera S.: confirmed. PM-6026 set to 2024-06-10. i'll add weekend phone fallback and exact escalation steps (who to call if pager fails).

Devon T.: confirmed. PM-6027 set to 2024-06-19. will include PromQL snippet and a curl health example: `curl -fsS https://infra-health/conn | jq .`

Ivy N.: one more action: capture the recurring cause (overlapping bulk jobs) and a mitigation plan (stagger windows + job-level backoff). who can draft a short design?

Carlos R.: i can draft the short design doc but assign to app teams for schedule changes. i'll open ACTION-7100 and link to PM-6025. due 2024-06-21.

Meera S.: can we also add a quick checkbox in the runbook for oncall: "If bulk jobs are running, disable next window and contact job owners" — small immediate mitigation.

Devon T.: agreed. i'll add an alert->runbook link so when alert fires the runbook URL is in the pager body.

Ivy N.: excellent. i'll setup a 20m runbook walkthrough with oncall next week after PRs merge. weekly 15m syncs until actions are green. tag PM-6025/6026/6027/ACTION-7100 in PRs. thanks team :thumbsup:
